methods.window: knowable: first Q4 PBP state at or below 3:00 through min(+10 wall minutes, last ESPN play), in-game only
methods.fit_coordinate: Market YES for all window fits; 1-cent bins; trade-weighted calibration; isotonic Prelec-II and raw fit; 2,000 game-cluster draws
methods.trade_gap_coordinate: Longshot/favorite folded probability; trade-level residuals averaged within game before game-cluster bootstrap
methods.dose_sample: Final 3 regulation game minutes by shared game_windows predicate; 0.03--0.97 market prices; in-game trades strictly before last ESPN play; wall-time bins use right-open intervals except 20+.
